scope: coordinator durable terminal-release recovery and sequential journal capacity; no20-full-game execution or universal availability claim
normalCompletedGameBehavior: engine deletes per-game search/reply records and resets game_jobs; coordinator prunes that game only after canonical terminal verification and acknowledged empty pinned-engine reservation
lostAcknowledgementRecovery: durable pending intent survives error callback and coordinator upgrade; fresh canonical terminal verification plus empty engine reservation acknowledges already committed release without another release call
lateCallbackProtection: pending/closed game guards suppress stale Job writes before/after pruning; closed tombstone rejects old requests
limits: An individual legal game exceeding1024plies is outside current service history bound and may need native service-timeout refund.
External RPC/IC availability and operating cycles remain bounded dependencies.
Relay ETH lifetime spending quota is separate from wallet balance and may require an authorized deployment/profile change after exhaustion.
